note: Reserve Bank of Fiji Annual Report August 2023-July 2024 (tabled in Parliament, parliament.gov.fj) was read at two offsets. The contents list an independent auditor's report at pp.79-81, but those pages extract as page headers only (image-based); the corporate governance section says the Board Audit and Risk Committee oversees external audit and that annual evaluations are done of internal and external auditors, but names no firm or Auditor-General.

Maldives Monetary Authority Annual Report 2024 (mma.gov.mv AR2024 English) read at three offsets. The independent auditor's report occupies pp.125-127: the responsibilities boilerplate extracts but the addressee and signature block do not (p.127 extracts blank), so no firm or office is named. The preface says only that the statements were 'examined and certified by the external auditors'.

Banco de Mocambique's standalone Demonstracoes Financeiras 2018 (bancomoc.mz) was read. Pages 6-9, where the Relatorio do Auditor Independente sits, extract as page numbers with no text. The only signature block that extracts is the Board's responsibility statement (Benedita Maria Guimino). No firm named.

Search for an AMCM (Monetary Authority of Macao) annual report or financial statements naming an independent auditor returned only Macao commercial banks' disclosures and a centralbanking.com index entry for the 2001 annual report; no AMCM auditor's report page was located to fetch.

Central Bank of Myanmar Law 2013 English text: the myanmartradeportal.gov.mm PDF failed to fetch (client_error) and the cacj-ajp.org page lists the law's 18 chapter titles only, including chapter 5 'Accountability and Transparency', with no section text. No auditor named from any readable source.

Central Bank of The Gambia Annual Report 2023 (cbg.gm downloads-file 0c006e2d-cd9b-11ef-8725-02e599c15748) contains governance, economic review and statistical tables including a 'Summary Account of The Central Bank' (Table 25), but no audited financial statements and no independent auditor's report in the extracted text. No firm named.

Searches for a Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe independent auditor's report returned only Zimbabwean commercial-bank and parastatal audits, Ernst & Young Zimbabwe's own firm accounts, and press coverage of an independent audit of the ZiG gold reserves (a separate reserves verification, not the RBZ financial-statement audit). No RBZ auditor's report located.

Searches in Portuguese for a Banco Nacional de Angola relatorio e contas or relatorio do auditor independente returned only Angolan commercial banks' audited accounts (BFA, BIC, BAI, Banco Economico, Access Bank) and BNA prudential avisos on external audit of supervised banks. No BNA financial-statement auditor's report located.

Reserve Bank of Malawi: the only located copy of the RBM Financial Statement 31 December 2024 is a Scribd upload, which returns a JavaScript-required error page and cannot be read. regalert.today document 9cb1c8e7 turned out to be the Financial Services (Annual Audits of Banks) Directive 2018, which regulates audits of supervised banks and names no auditor of the RBM itself.

Central Bank of Eswatini: searches for the Annual Integrated Report PDF returned a link on independentnews.co.sz that resolves to that news site's homepage, plus BIS transcripts of the Governor's report presentations and press coverage of the Bank's profit. No auditor's report page reached; no firm named.

Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan: searches returned Royal Audit Authority annual audit reports (bhutanaudit.gov.bt) covering government accounts generally and old RMA annual reports from 2001-2008 on apfanews.com, none fetched within budget. No provision or report naming the RMA's auditor was read.
